prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Ribbon by the Pot; World Discovery; fiction.
Setting: Classroom craft corner with one window table and one low shelf. Two clearly different plant pots remain visible from the main table: tall blue pot at window, small yellow pot on shelf.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One brown-paper parcel without ribbon; One long red ribbon; One tall blue plant pot on the window table; One small yellow plant pot on the low shelf; One craft table
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 7. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): His hand closes around the red ribbon. He carries it to Zoe, keeping the long end off the floor.
Required illustration: Kit returns with the one red ribbon gathered loosely in both hands; Zoe steadies the paper parcel on the craft table. Continuity: Ribbon transferred from shelf to table; no duplicate at pot or on parcel yet.
Exact current state: Ribbon transferred from shelf to table; no duplicate at pot or on parcel yet.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
Production clarity: one coherent appealing natural scene, ordinary child-scale furniture and adult proportions where relevant. Essential people and all focal props entirely at least 10 percent inside all four image edges; preserve readable medium-wide composition on 3:2 canvas. Natural hands with correct fingers and contact, no intersecting chair/body/table geometry, no giant room-enclosing shelves. References show multiple designs and times: use ONLY current scene inventory. Preserve the established room geometry and fixed prop locations across pages. Do not insert future completed states.
Inventory invariant: exactly TWO plants in the room: one tall BLUE pot on blue saucer at LEFT window table with teal watering can; one small YELLOW pot on RIGHT low shelf. One loose RED ribbon stays beside YELLOW pot until page7. One brown parcel stays on front craft table UNTIED until page8; NEVER show a future bow. One ribbon only. Do not move either pot while changing camera.
Third reference is actual accepted opening scene: preserve the room geography and furniture dimensions and its generous medium-wide framing, while changing to EXACT current-page state. Do not repeat its initial prop inventory. Full shoes must be visibly on FLOOR, never perched on chairs, unless explicitly seated naturally. Use normal standing, kneeling or sitting posture without furniture/limb intersection. 
Preserve THREE ordinary small blue plastic chairs around same child-sized craft table, spatially apart from both standing children: two viewer-side left/right, third far side partly hidden. Children have feet naturally on floor, NEVER on chairs. Same light wooden table with gray metal legs. One parcel only. Yellow shelf pot at RIGHT has NO ribbon remaining after pickup; p7 ribbon solely gathered in Kit hands, parcel still untied; p8 same ribbon forms exactly one two-loop red bow, children's hands naturally tie. Do not duplicate ribbon near pot or on floor. Complete focal subjects and props10% inside edges.

visualReview.note: One red ribbon held safely in both Kit hands, none beside yellow pot or around parcel; Zoe steadies parcel.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
